purpose: No root package: a pnpm TypeScript app under apps/, a .NET solution whose test project belongs to it, a second .NET service, and a load-test package under bench/. The app is found with its own pnpm install and its nested lint, type-check, build and test scripts, and the bench package is listed as a satellite, not a component. Its type-check script only loads the code with Node's type stripping, which checks no types, so under rubric 2026-12-beta it passes with the type error the audit plants in src/cart.ts: checkout-web is at Level 1 (it was Level 2 under 2026-11-beta), and making its type-check cover src/cart.ts is the top step, since it would take 56% of recent changes to Level 2. Both .NET parts are now assessed: global.json pins SDK 10.0.100 under the default patch policy, which the image's 10.0.404 doesn't satisfy, so the audit adds 10.0.100 before the restore. commerce-core builds, but its test project references no test SDK or framework, so the audit finds no command that runs its test file: under rubric 2026-12-beta that is undetermined, not "no tests" (it was Level 0 before), and the report says adding the test command settles it. identity-dev uses WebApplication without implicit usings and doesn't build, and has no test files, so it is at Level 0 and sets the repo level (the bench satellite's own changes count toward the shares). With no test command for either service, the targeted-tests signal is now false.
